credentials.description: Workspace ID sent as `anthropic-workspace-id`. Required unless `workspaceID` is set in settings.
AWS region used for the endpoint host and SigV4 signing. Required unless `region` or `baseURL` is set.
Fallback region, read when `AWS_REGION` is not set.
API key sent as `x-api-key`. When present, it is used instead of SigV4 signing.
Access key for SigV4 signing when no API key or credential provider is configured.
Secret key for SigV4 signing when no API key or credential provider is configured.
Optional session token for temporary SigV4 credentials.

notes: Claude models through Anthropic's Claude Platform on AWS, authenticated with an Anthropic AWS API key or AWS SigV4 credentials and scoped to a workspace. It uses the same Messages adapter as the Anthropic provider, including message threads, files and skills.
